learning_outcomes.text: Acquire skills for analysis and synthesis of technical and organizing solutions in production processes and equipment safety application.
Assimilate the main terms, definitions and categories in risk and safety theory.
Assimilate the principles and methods for technical and producing systems risk analysis.
Assimilate risk sources, characteristics, actions, normalizing, measurements and evaluation of the standardized in Bulgarian and international standards risk factors.
Assimilate the methods for creation of safety technical and production systems.

syllabus_topics: Ergonomic fundamentals of technical and manufacturing systems safety
Social and economic effectiveness of safety

assessment_methods.method: Two written tests on pre-given topics

assessment_rules: The final mark is formed considering the results of both tests and successful participation in practice sessions. Students are required to be prepared in advance on lecture themes, which is checked by questions.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
